property_summary: For every caller and deposit amount, only the owner can drain the contract via withdrawAll — so after any non-owner calls withdrawAll the contract balance remains unchanged; the mutant removing the onlyOwner check allows a non-owner to successfully withdraw and reduce the contract balance for some fuzzed caller/amount.
change_summary: Removed the require check so onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts access, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll and affect observed balance.
